segments.speaker: Laura Bennett
segments.text: Petr, did you get a chance to look at the empty states for the words list?

segments.speaker: Petr Ivanov
segments.text: Yes, I have looked on them in the morning. I think they are good, but the illustration is to big on small phones.

segments.speaker: Laura Bennett
segments.text: Good point. Could you suggest a size?

segments.speaker: Petr Ivanov
segments.text: Maybe 120 points instead of 200. Also the text says "You have no words", it sounds little bit sad.

segments.speaker: Laura Bennett
segments.text: Ha, fair. What about "Your words will show up here after your first call"?

segments.speaker: Petr Ivanov
segments.text: Definately better. I will recieve the new copy from you and update the mockups untill tomorrow.
